title: Movie Studio Simulator
author: Own-Satisfaction5439
selftext:
I’ve been working on a browser-based Hollywood movie studio simulator, using ChatGPT to help build and improve it.

The idea is to simulate running a film studio, from developing movies and managing budgets to competing with other studios and tracking box office performance.

Some of the features I’ve worked on include:

* 🎬 **Movie production:** Develop films and manage production budgets.
* 🏢 **Studio management:** Play in Single Studio or Empire Mode.
* 🎞️ **Franchises and IP:** Work with recognizable studios and movie franchises.
* 📺 **TV and streaming:** Greenlight shows and manage their releases.
* 📰 **Industry simulation:** Follow fictional industry news, social reactions, and trade coverage.

I’ve also tested long simulations to check how the game behaves over time.

I’m still improving the project, and I’d genuinely appreciate feedback.

  
[https://theout.itch.io/hollywood-simulator](https://theout.itch.io/hollywood-simulator)
